caption: The drawing depicts a single glass bottle with a light blue-green hue, placed centrally against an off-white background. The bottle has a distinctive, irregularly shaped body that is wider at the bottom and tapers toward a short, cylindrical neck with an open mouth. The body features a prominent embossed circular pattern on its front face, consisting of concentric circles at the center with radiating straight lines extending outward. The glass shows subtle shading to indicate its curvature and thickness, as well as mild reflections and transparency. The outline and internal detailing of the bottle are rendered in darker blue and grayish tones, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. The artist's signature, "V.L. VANCE," is visible in small, capitalized letters at the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Blue-Green Flask
